query: The statutory investigation period expired without a charge sheet, so the accused claims default bail under Section 167(2).
The accused seeks anticipatory bail in a PMLA money-laundering investigation where the agency says custodial interrogation is necessary.
Pre-arrest protection under Section 438 should continue without an arbitrary fixed time limit.
The undertrial has remained in custody for a long time and the trial is unlikely to finish soon.
The accused seeks regular bail; attendance can be secured and there is no supported risk of witness tampering or absconding.
